title: Set the project name and number in Project Information
task: Read and set the project's Name and Number through Document.ProjectInformation (a ProjectInfo element every project has) inside one Connector.WithTransaction block, and return the values read back after the commit.

miss.text: set the project name and number

pitfalls.symptom: Setting ProjectInfo.Name outside a block fails with script-write-outside-transaction.
pitfalls.cause: Every write, even to a settings-style element like ProjectInfo, is a document modification.
